cues.text: Under a heavy, blue-grey sky, two massive, ox-like beasts stand in a flooded plain. They have thick brown coats and crowns of long, jagged horns.
High above, a bright spark of light trails downwards. The colony ship's landing craft.
The beasts wait in the wet, swaying grass as the distant craft slips behind snow-dusted hills on the horizon.

beats.note: Two large ox-like beasts stand in a marshy plain with tall grass and pools of water. The sky is overcast and blue-grey.
A bright streak of light appears in the sky, descending.
The streak of light continues descending towards the distant hills.
The streak of light disappears behind the hills. The beasts remain standing in the grass.
